digest.component_or_area: completion verification banking and verdict assembly
propositions: At search exhaustion, completion verifier incorrectly banks fallback evidence as met=false (refutation) instead of distinguishing insufficient evidence from positive refutation, causing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was not reached within the search window.

The banking write path must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient) via an optional evidence_sufficient:false framework-set marker that rides alongside met=false, preserving unchanged fail-closed consumer behavior while accurately representing exhaustion.

Fallback-banked insufficient entries must retain their evidence_sufficient marker after re-harvest by marker-less successors, while genuine refutations (bare met=false) replace prior entries and clear the marker.

All absence-of-evidence flows must route through the framework's marker path (never model-tool input); record_criterion_verdict stays bool-only with new semantics: met=false only on positive refutation, not-found records nothing, and the bounded fallback banks the marker.

Both rendering seams (verdict assembly and finalizer merge) must emit met=false + evidence_sufficient:false for insufficient entries with insufficient-evidence findings text, and merge_finalizer_with_bank must re-stamp from the bank as authoritative source over model echoes.

The audit ticket page verdict consumer was missing from the enumeration and incorrectly discriminated PASS vs FAIL by sidecar shape; it must key on the verdict field itself, and insufficient-evidence remediation must steer operators away from mis-tagging code-verifiable criteria as operator-attested.
